title: Every failure is a closed error envelope and an error is never a verdict
statement: Every failure the runtime reports MUST be an error envelope validating against law/schemas/error.schema.json with a code, a class, an exit code, and a message, and a crash, timeout, missing input, or infrastructure failure MUST NOT manufacture a PASS, a FAIL, or a readiness claim.
rationale: Article 41 separates a failure to observe from an observation. The error contract is the one shape every package uses to say so.

strategy.rationale: A deterministic test corpus under tests/ and packages/*/tests observes this obligation; trace links the tests.
